svg.title: One agent, four skills
svg.desc: Claude Code with the vr-dev plugin uses four skills. Headless Blender builds validated assets for Unity; Unity runs the app on the Meta XR Simulator, driven through the XR Operator and DevRemote; development builds go to a Quest 3 or 3S over adb with a scripted readout. The Horizon OS MCP serves Meta docs, device control and Perfetto traces to every stage.
